title: Cards
intro: Takere's main surface: 18 px corners, a hairline border and a soft shadow on the gray canvas.

basic.title: Basic card
basic.description: 16 px semibold title, with an action or status on the right.
basic.body: The patient completed 12 of 14 scheduled tasks. Water and medication logs are complete.

careBlock.title: Care block
careBlock.description: Groups the items for one time slot in the plan. Each row has a type icon, name and actions.

stat.title: Stat
stat.description: Highlighted number with a label and an icon in a soft square.

interactive.title: Clickable card
interactive.description: Lifts 4 px and deepens its shadow on hover. Use only when the whole card is a link.

guidelines.do1: Group only related information in the same card.
guidelines.do2: Use a 1-column grid on mobile and 2–3 columns on desktop.
guidelines.dont2: Don't use hover elevation on cards that aren't clickable.
